case.summary: Alert HHG-010 was triggered by an elevated legacy risk score of 0.90 on online transaction 3506725 ($1,000.03) on card C10434-K1. Although the purchase amount was higher than recent transactions and made on a newly seen generic device, the calibrated second-generation model score was exceptionally low at 0.019 with a 0.6% historical fraud rate. The transaction occurred in the cardholder's primary billing region 469, and the account has no association with fraud rings or elevated-risk communities. In addition, the card's sole prior closed case (CC-0873) was cleared as a false alarm, and the cardholder profile exhibits no compromise history. The transaction was ruled legitimate cardholder activity and closed with no fraud identified.
